{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I'm sure Captain Obrim has your comlink code at the very top of his list, should there be any good news for you.|[[Kal Skirata]] to [[Mar Rugeyan]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
A '''comlink code''' or '''com code''' was a pre-programmed frequency set into each communications device by its manufacturers. Long and complex, they were unique to each individual device. On many [[Planet/Legends|planets]], there was a directory of all registered com codes.
